wnba.Headline: Lynx win over Fever attracts rallies for, against Cunningham
wnba.Description: A crowd of critics and supporters of Indiana guard Sophie Cunningham's stance on transgender participation in women's sports gathered around and inside Target Center in Minneapolis as the Indiana Fever lost 108-100 to the Minnesota Lynx on Sunday.

wnba.Headline: Olivia Miles, Courtney Williams combine for 55 points, Lynx hold off Fever 108-100
wnba.Description: — Rookie sensation Olivia Miles spearheaded an efficient offense with 28 points, Courtney Williams added 27 points, and the Minnesota Lynx won their 10th-straight game with a 108-100 win over the Indiana Fever on Sunday.

wnba.Headline: Sparks trade All-Star guard Kelsey Plum to Mercury
wnba.Description: The Sparks have traded five-time All-Star Kelsey Plum to the Mercury for Monique Akoa Makani, a 2027 first-round pick and a 2028 second-rounder.

wnba.Headline: Inside the disunited United States that shadows the WNBA
wnba.Description: Sophie Cunningham said what she said about transgender women in sports. Now others want their say, whether the WNBA wants to hear them or not.

wnba.Headline: Sky's Sydney Taylor lets it 'fly,' dumps Aces with late 3-pointer
wnba.Description: Sydney Taylor hit a go-ahead 3-pointer to beat the defending champion Aces 84-83, became the first rookie in Sky franchise history to sink a 3 in the final five seconds of the fourth quarter or overtime.

wnba.Headline: Ionescu has 27 points, 10 rebounds as Liberty edge Mercury 94-92
